non_transferred_parameters.consequence: the remote endpoint manages its own context window; no equivalent field exists on the frozen OpenAI-compatible transport, so the allocation cannot be held equal and is not claimed to be
a remote endpoint publishes no content digest. A provider-reported model id can be observed, and it is strictly weaker: it cannot detect a silent revision change behind a stable id
there is no resident process to sample. The criterion is NOT substituted by a look-alike; it is declared inapplicable and the readiness verdict says so

stop_rules: the in-run qualification turn is a pre-flight gate: if it does not reach COMPLETE with a lawful terminal, the round STOPS and no scientific turn runs
any scientific turn that does not reach COMPLETE makes the run INCONCLUSIVE; there is no retry, no substitution and no extension
the run executes exactly the frozen schedule; the turn count and order are never adjusted while running
the post-state is frozen with `scored: false` BEFORE the scorer is run
no request, prompt, scorer, predicate, timeout, budget or generation setting may change once the first scientific call is made
